question: In a certain code language, FLOWER is written as UOLDVI. How will FMRJFV be written as in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b45f452be17f5b54f8c46069c39e0f6c931d4ce8190ab0d96cc01665e3726746.png] 

FLOWER ⇔ UOLDVI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d081bfae3a7e8fbc71458aed104afdb1db877a3f65c35d94e60c524e39b38641.png] 

Similarly,

FMRJFV ⇔ UNIQUE 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa2b17b939c1be5679f0f605aae8267fb86981696ca6201ed99f9520001a05ce.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is UNIQUE.
